en: The postcard depicts an old library room with a vaulted ceiling and arched supports. There are several wooden bookcases filled with books and objects along the walls. The floor appears to be wood, and the room is sparsely furnished aside from the bookcases. The image has a sepia tone, giving it a historical feel. The bottom of the postcard contains text in German.
